title: docs/labconstrictor-project.yaml
description: How a project around LabConstrictor (a plugin, a library, a web form) describes itself on the LabConstrictor website's Ecosystem page. Kept in the project's own repository at docs/labconstrictor-project.yaml.

summary.description: One or two plain-text sentences for the card.

status.description: Stage shown as a badge. Experimental: untested, may change; Available: ready to use; Install from GitHub: works, installed from the repository; Deprecated: no longer maintained. Keep it true: the site shows it as written.

url.description: Where the card links, when it is not the repository (for example a hosted web app).
